title: An econometrician's guide to optimal transport
abstract: arXiv:2604.04227v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose an overview of optimal transport theory and its applications to econometric methodology. This review is specifically designed for practitioners, be they econometric theorists or applied econometricians. The review of applications of optimal transport to econometrics is organized around the particular aspects of the mathematical theory of optimal transport they rely on.
